title: BPBond 솔로 #026 · 아워글래스SSBBW · Turkish İznik tile · 하블 체인 · plump glossy rose-coral lips
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Korean woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, glowing dewy skin, a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips, a poised, refined, confident expression, sultry, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real living eyes. Long square nails, chrome finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Turkish İznik tile — a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems, wide cobalt-and-coral bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense floral scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Restraints: She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, runs to a huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall at head height beside her. Heavy medieval iron fetters circle her legs just above each knee and just above each ankle, each with a heavy iron ring, the two knee fetters joined by a short heavy chain and the two ankle fetters joined by a short heavy chain, her steps cut short.

Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her feet close together, her arms relaxed at her sides, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: Extreme cobalt-and-coral platform high-heel mules, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Background & Lighting: the dim torchlight and flickering light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
